scripts.build:birthday: bun run src/birthday/_genIcs.ts && APP=birthday rsbuild build && cp README.md dist/birthday/
scripts.build:scotland-rail: APP=scotland-rail rsbuild build && cp README.md dist/scotland-rail/
scripts.deploy:root: bun run build && gh-pages --dist dist/root --branch master --dest . --add; rm -rf dist/root
scripts.deploy:birthday: bun run build:birthday && gh-pages --dist dist/birthday --branch master --dest birthday --add; rm -rf dist/birthday
scripts.deploy:scotland-rail: bun run build:scotland-rail && gh-pages --dist dist/scotland-rail --branch master --dest scotland-rail --add; rm -rf dist/scotland-rail
scripts.deploy:all: bun run build:all && bun run deploy:root-only && bun run deploy:birthday-only && bun run deploy:scotland-rail-only; rm -rf dist
scripts.check: bun run --sequential --no-exit-on-error check:clean check:deno check:oxlint check:biome check:export lint
